name: Bog Hound

abilities.name: Drag Under
abilities.description: While the hound is in water and has a creature grappled, at the start of each of its turns, the hound pulls a creature it is grappling feet toward or beneath the water's surface; if the creature ends its turn fully submerged and cannot breathe water, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw.

abilities.name: Whelm
abilities.description: As a bonus action, the hound whelms one Medium or smaller creature it is grappling. While whelmed, the target is blinded and restrained, has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the hound, and takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of the hound's turns. The hound can have only one creature whelmed at a time. If the hound takes 5 damage or more in a single turn from the whelmed creature, the hound must release the target at the end of that turn, and the target exits prone in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the hound. If the hound dies, a whelmed creature pulls free prone by using 5 feet of movement.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hound makes two Bite attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Opportunist's Lash.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 11). While grappled, the target is restrained.

actions.name: Opportunist's Lash
actions.description: One creature within 30 feet of the hound that is grappled by it must make a DC 13 Strength saving throw, taking 11 (2d10) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

generation.userConcept: a mud-caked bog hound that drags fishermen under
